description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to shape the future of patient care, ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance within a supportive environment. We are looking for a leader who is passionate about nursing excellence and committed to fostering a positive and productive work culture.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, staff development, and patient care initiatives. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking to fill this critical leadership position quickly with a candidate who can make an immediate impact. Join a team that values your expertise and provides a platform for professional growth.
requirements: Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing nursing facilities
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, compensation based on experience.

description: Are you a highly motivated and ambitious Registered Nurse with expertise in MDS coordination? A premier skilled nursing facility in Lititz, PA, is seeking a dedicated RN MDS Coordinator to join their dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to leverage your clinical assessment skills and contribute significantly to resident care planning within a supportive environment.In this vital role, you will be responsible for the timely and accurate completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring compliance with federal and state regulations. We are looking for a professional who thrives in a fast-paced setting and is passionate about making a tangible difference in the lives of residents.This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $60,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting your experience and commitment. If you are ready to bring your energy and expertise to a role where your contributions are highly valued, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Pennsylvania.
Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator or RNAC, with strong knowledge of MDS 3.0.
Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
Demonstrated ambition and motivation to excel in a dynamic healthcare setting.
Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
salaryOrBonusInfo: $60,000 - $95,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.
